versions.changelog:
- Initial release of jike-hot-cn: 即刻热门话题监控 (Jike Hot Topics Monitor)
- Fetch trending posts, circle (community) discussions, and user highlights from Jike.
- Supports filtering by categories such as tech, investment, life, and workplace circles.
- Provides output with topic details, source circle, likes, and comments.
- Simple command triggers for access to trending and categorized content.
